bull.probability_evidence: Growth Portfolio already supplies 55% of revenue with 7 assets each annualising above $1bn (bull case, bms.com investors), and recent proof points landed in the weeks before this evaluation: FDA pediatric label expansion for Camzyos (2026-09-30), first Phase 3 EXCALIBER-RRMM data for iberdomide (2026-09-25) and a cell therapy meeting its primary endpoint in a mid-stage trial (2026-09-08) (evaluation bull case; fact sheet News & sentiment). The bull case itself flags the re-rating as conditional on Q3 results (Oct 29, 2026) confirming the Growth Portfolio offsets legacy erosion [Guessing tag in bull case], which the evaluator has not yet seen, so it is weighted lowest (25%) of the three scenarios.

target_band.cite: Bull's basis re-rates EV/EBITDA to its 5y max of 9.8x (factsheet-2026-10-07.md Valuation table, RA), implying $71.22 on the current price of $59.59 (RA/HI) holding fundamentals constant. Applying the identical move-to-5y-max to the other two multiples not distorted by the FY2024 one-off net-income swing (note sec.6; fact sheet IS/RA) -- EV/Sales (3.2x->4.1x) and P/FCF (10.6x->13.4x) -- implies $76.35 and $75.33 respectively (P/E and P/B excluded: both derive from net income/book value, which FY2024's -18.5% net margin and -38.9% ROE distort, per note sec.6). Half the spread ($76.35-$71.22)/2=$2.57 is 3.5% of the $74 target, below the 25.6% blended residual volatility (mc-inputs.json regression.residual_vol.blended).

base.probability_evidence: The bear case's own finding -- EV/EBITDA at 8.2x is 'essentially its 5y median of 8.1x' (evaluation bear case, RA) -- shows the stock is already priced near its historical cash-flow-multiple centre, making 'growth assets and legacy erosion roughly net out' (base basis) the single most likely path rather than a re-rating or de-rating; the decision rationale calls the expected 12m return 'roughly flat', consistent with weighting this outcome the plurality (45%).

target_band.cite: Base's basis holds EV/EBITDA near its 5y median of 8.1x (8.2x now; factsheet RA), implying $58.86 on the current $59.59 (HI). Applying the identical move-to-5y-median to EV/Sales (3.2x->3.3x) and P/FCF (10.6x->8.5x) -- the two other multiples unaffected by the FY2024 net-income anomaly (note sec.6) -- implies $61.45 and $47.78 respectively; the P/FCF anchor is pulled down because current P/FCF (10.6x) sits above its own 5y median (8.5x; fact sheet RA), exactly the disagreement the bear case highlights ('on cash flow, the stock is not cheap against its own history'). Half the spread ($61.45-$47.78)/2=$6.84 is 11.4% of the $60 target, below the 25.6% blended residual volatility (mc-inputs.json regression.residual_vol.blended).

bear.probability_evidence: The deteriorating-fundamentals trend is already running: FCF margin down from 32.8% to 23.3% TTM, FCF/NI conversion down from 217.8% to 123.2%, net debt/EBITDA up from 1.47x to 1.80x (note sec.5; fact sheet CF/IS/BS), Altman Z at 2.59 in the 'grey zone' (note sec.6; fact sheet ST), against Eliquis/Revlimid loss-of-exclusivity still ahead (note sec.1-2). The evaluator weights this continuation path second-highest (30%, above bull's 25%) given the trend lines are presently moving the wrong way, not yet the base case.

target_band.cite: Bear's basis reverts P/FCF to its 5y median of 8.5x from 10.6x (factsheet RA), implying $47.78 on the current $59.59 (HI) -- matching the stated $48 target closely. Applying the identical move-to-5y-median to EV/EBITDA (8.2x->8.1x) and EV/Sales (3.2x->3.3x) -- the two other multiples unaffected by the FY2024 net-income anomaly (note sec.6) -- implies $58.86 and $61.45 respectively, i.e. little further downside signal since both are already at or below their own median (the exact disagreement the bear case flags for EV/EBITDA: 'essentially its 5y median'). Half the spread ($61.45-$47.78)/2=$6.84 is 14.2% of the $48 target, below the 25.6% blended residual volatility (mc-inputs.json regression.residual_vol.blended).
